the justification is weak."},{"where":"Orbit","issue":"States RAAN initial value 27.33° indicates the launch facility location; RAAN is not a site location and this is incorrect."},{"where":"Ground Control & Communications","issue":"STK access table lists row 15 as a duplicate of row 14 and the total of 8711.797 s excludes it, so the statistics are inconsistent."},{"where":"Mission Duration & EOL","issue":"Passive versus controlled disposal reasoning is confused; Substantial revision is needed."}
